answer_2.quote: A straightforward metric to evaluate dialogue systems is the success rate tested by each user simulator. ... we also use automatic measures such as average utterance length, vocabulary size, Dist-1, Dist-2 and Entropy to evaluate user simulators.

answer_4.quote: We ask humans to converse with dialogue systems. Each dialogue system has conversed with 5 different users; each user has 10 dialogues. ... We use five same metrics as ... which are Fluency, Coherence, Goal Adherence, Diversity, and Overall quality to assess user simulators from multiple aspects.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators were instructed to interact with each system using predefined user goals and then rate the dialogues based on several criteria such as fluency, coherence, goal adherence, diversity, and overall quality.
